name: taskplane
description: AI software-delivery control plane for Claude and Codex: simple design, build, review, and status prompts backed by dependency-aware readiness, scoped execution, fingerprinted evidence, 26-lens review, and human approval.

interface.longDescription: taskplane is the AI software-delivery control plane for heavy users who design, build, and review code with Claude or Codex every day. Ask simply to design, build, review, or show status while a strict execution harness stays behind the scenes. Design turns a refined requirement and current code into alternatives plus a human-approved, fingerprinted Design Contract with a proposed graph overlay, named contracts, bounded depth, Design DoR/DoD, validation traceability, risks, rollout, and conditional visualization—without changing product code. Definition of Ready blocks under-specified or dependency-ambiguous work; scoped contracts constrain execution; workers submit fingerprinted evidence for orchestrator-only Definition-of-Done gates; and a full 26-lens engineering review exposes solution design, architecture, security, operability, data, UX, and other consequences for technical and nontechnical decision-makers. Distributed-system reasoning stops at explicit contracts between entities by default.
capabilities: Enforce Definition of Ready before implementation begins
Approve a proposed-HOW Design Contract before complex implementation
Carry dependency overlays, named contracts, and graph DoR/DoD from Design into Build and Review
Constrain execution to an approved task scope
Require evidence-backed Definition of Done before sign-off
Gate dependency and contract impact at Ready and Done
Separate worker submissions from orchestrator validation
Review code and solution designs through 26 engineering lenses
Publish progress artifacts for team handoff
Show status on demand: current step, gates, and what taskplane is waiting on
defaultPrompt: taskplane design this feature before implementation and show me the key choices.
taskplane build this feature and ask me only for material decisions.
taskplane review this branch without changing code.
